text: ExpansionList replaces or appends an ordered vector of expansion properties and omits an empty pair. It joins properties with commas and uses literal expand without a dollar for all generated requests; the source comment gives an unverified delta-workaround rationale. ExpandOptions formats nested selection/filter clauses with semicolons inside property parentheses, then request construction applies the outer form serializer. Generated variants do not prove endpoint support. The initial tests check populated formatting/URIs, not replacement, empty queries or real requests. No new execution occurred.
title: Graph expansion options are formatted before one outer query encoding step
